pack.author: ai
pack.notes: Original creative direction; no external assets.

data.description: A 5 to 10 second channel intro that states who the channel is and what the viewer gets, then gets out of the way. Energy up front, logo and name locked in the last two seconds.

brief.mood: Confident, bright and friendly; energetic without being noisy.
brief.pacing: Fast: beats every 0.4 to 0.6 seconds for the first half, then a held 1.5 second logo lock-up. Animations snap in and ease out.
structure: Hook (0-1.5 s): a bold shape or colour burst on the beat
Promise (1.5-4 s): one line saying what the channel gives, max 6 words
Channel name and logo reveal (4-7 s)
Hold the lock-up for at least 1.5 s with a subtle loop
Optional subscribe hint as a small badge, never a pop-up
doNot: No text smaller than 6% of the frame height
Do not cover the logo with particles or light leaks
No generic 'Welcome to my channel' line
brief.qualityBar: The name is readable on a phone at the end frame; the first frame is already interesting as a thumbnail; it loops cleanly if replayed.
